group.passage:
Millions of people have played with the Rubik's Cube, a colorful puzzle that fits in one hand. Few of them know, however, that it was first made as a tool for [[1]], not as a toy. In 1974, Erno Rubik was a young design teacher in Budapest, Hungary. His students found it hard to imagine how solid shapes move and turn, so he wanted to give them a model they could hold in their hands.
Rubik cut small blocks of wood and tried to join them into one big cube. The hard part was letting each layer turn freely without making the whole cube [[2]]. After many failed tries, he finally found a clever way to hold the pieces together. He then painted each side a different color and began to twist it. Soon the colors were all mixed up, and getting them back in order was far from easy. It took Rubik more than a month to [[3]] his own puzzle!
His students loved the cube, and Rubik realized that others might enjoy it too. In 1977, it went on [[4]] in toy shops in Hungary. A few years later, it was sold all over the world. Today, the cube [[5]] as one of the best-selling toys in history.

tags.key_phrase: a tool for teaching, not a toy
be known as（被認為是、被稱為）

1.explanation_zh: 本句說魔術方塊「最早是被當成一種＿＿的工具，而不是玩具」，本句本身沒有說是什麼工具。下一句說 1974 年發明者 Erno Rubik 是一位年輕的設計老師，再下一句說他的學生很難想像立體形狀轉動後的樣子——可見方塊是老師為了「教學」而做的。teaching（教學）。
evidence: Few of them know, however, that it was first made as a tool for [[1]], not as a toy.
In 1974, Erno Rubik was a young design teacher in Budapest, Hungary.

option_notes_zh.A: cooking（烹飪）：只讀本句說得通（最早是當成烹飪工具），但要看下一句 In 1974, Erno Rubik was a young design teacher in Budapest, Hungary. 才能排除——發明者是老師，做方塊是為了他的學生，和做菜無關。
option_notes_zh.C: farming（農耕）：只讀本句說得通，但下一句說發明者是設計老師，接著談的是他的學生學習立體形狀，和種田無關。
option_notes_zh.D: fishing（釣魚）：只讀本句也說得通，但上下文講的是老師和學生，和釣魚無關。

1.strategy_zh: 本句只說「不是玩具」，沒說是什麼工具；往下讀一兩句，看發明者的身分和他想幫助的人。
hints: 空格要填名詞（動名詞），放在 a tool for ＿ 裡。
看下一句：Erno Rubik 的身分是什麼？
設計老師為學生做的工具：teaching（教學）。

2.explanation_zh: 難處在於讓每一層都能自由轉動，又不會讓整個方塊「散開、解體」。fall apart（散開、瓦解）；make＋受詞＋原形動詞。下一句說他終於找到聰明的方法把小塊固定在一起（hold the pieces together），正好是「不散開」。
evidence: The hard part was letting each layer turn freely without making the whole cube [[2]].
After many failed tries, he finally found a clever way to hold the pieces together.

option_notes_zh.A: fall asleep（睡著）：方塊不會睡著，說不通。
option_notes_zh.B: get lost（迷路、走失）：轉動各層不會讓整個方塊迷路，說不通。
option_notes_zh.C: dry up（乾掉、枯竭）：木頭方塊不會因為轉動而「乾掉」，和轉動無關。

2.strategy_zh: 由 without 看出空格是「要避免的壞結果」；下一句的 hold the pieces together（把小塊固定在一起）正好是 fall apart 的相反。
hints: 空格要填片語動詞，放在 make＋受詞＋原形動詞 裡。
下一句：他終於找到方法把小塊 hold together。
每一層都能轉，整個方塊又不會散掉：fall apart。

3.explanation_zh: 前一句說顏色很快就完全混在一起，要把它們排回原來的樣子一點也不容易（far from easy）；所以 Rubik 花了一個多月才「解開」自己做的謎題。solve a puzzle（解開謎題）。
evidence: Soon the colors were all mixed up, and getting them back in order was far from easy.
It took Rubik more than a month to [[3]] his own puzzle!

option_notes_zh.B: sell（賣）：只讀本句說得通（花一個多月才賣出），但要看前一句 Soon the colors were all mixed up, and getting them back in order was far from easy. 才能排除——難的是把顏色排回原位，花時間的是「解開」，不是「賣出」；下一段也才說它 1977 年開始在店裡販售。
option_notes_zh.C: name（命名）：只讀本句說得通（花一個多月才替它取名），但前一句談的是把顏色排回原位很難，和取名字無關。
option_notes_zh.D: borrow（借入）：方塊是他自己做的（his own puzzle），不需要「借」，說不通。

3.strategy_zh: It took … to V 的「花很久」要和前一句的「很難」連起來：難在把顏色排回去，所以是「解開」。
hints: 空格要填原形動詞（to＋V），受詞是 his own puzzle。
前一句：顏色全混在一起，要排回原位一點也不容易。

4.explanation_zh: go on sale（開始販售、上市）是固定搭配。1977 年魔術方塊在匈牙利的玩具店「開始販售」；下一句也說幾年後它就賣到全世界（it was sold all over the world）。
evidence: In 1977, it went on [[4]] in toy shops in Hungary.
A few years later, it was sold all over the world.

option_notes_zh.A: diet：go on a diet 是「節食」，方塊不會節食；而且這裡沒有冠詞 a。
option_notes_zh.B: vacation：go on vacation 是「去度假」，方塊不會去度假。
option_notes_zh.D: tour：go on tour 是「巡迴演出」，用在樂團、表演者，方塊不會在玩具店巡迴演出。

4.strategy_zh: 主詞 it 是魔術方塊，地點是 toy shops（玩具店）：東西在店裡 go on sale＝開始販售。
hints: 空格要填名詞，和 went on 組成片語。
地點是 toy shops；下一句說它後來賣到全世界。
在玩具店開始販售：go on sale。

5.explanation_zh: 主詞 the cube 是「被大家認為是」史上最暢銷的玩具之一，要用被動語態 be known as；Today 說的是現在，用現在式 is known。
evidence: Today, the cube [[5]] as one of the best-selling toys in history.

option_notes_zh.A: knows：主動語態，變成「方塊知道……」；方塊不會知道事情，主詞和動作的關係不對。
option_notes_zh.C: has known：仍是主動語態（方塊已經知道），主詞和動作的關係不對。
option_notes_zh.D: is knowing：know 表示狀態，通常不用進行式；而且仍是主動，意思不通。

5.strategy_zh: 主詞是物（the cube），後面接 as one of…：想到被動的 be known as（被認為是）。
hints: 空格是本句的動詞，主詞是 the cube。
方塊是「被」大家當成最暢銷的玩具之一。
被動語態 be known as：is known。

translation_zh.text:
有數百萬人玩過魔術方塊，這是一個可以握在一隻手裡的彩色謎題。不過，很少人知道，它最早是被做成一種教學工具，而不是玩具。1974 年，魯比克（Erno Rubik）是匈牙利布達佩斯一位年輕的設計老師。他的學生很難想像立體形狀是怎麼移動、轉動的，所以他想給學生一個可以拿在手上的模型。
魯比克把木頭切成小方塊，試著把它們組成一個大方塊。困難的地方在於，要讓每一層都能自由轉動，又不會讓整個方塊散開。試了很多次都失敗之後，他終於想出一個聰明的方法，把各個小塊固定在一起。接著他把每一面塗上不同的顏色，開始轉動它。很快地，顏色就全混在一起了，要把它們排回原來的樣子一點也不容易。魯比克花了一個多月，才解開自己做的這個謎題！
他的學生都很喜歡這個方塊，魯比克也發現其他人可能同樣會喜歡它。1977 年，它在匈牙利的玩具店開始販售。幾年後，它賣到了世界各地。如今，魔術方塊被認為是史上最暢銷的玩具之一。

evidence: In 1974, Erno Rubik was a young design teacher in Budapest, Hungary.
His students found it hard to imagine how solid shapes move and turn, so he wanted to give them a model they could hold in their hands.
1.explanation_zh: Rubik 是設計老師，做方塊是為了幫學生理解立體形狀，所以是教學工具（teaching）。

evidence: The hard part was letting each layer turn freely without making the whole cube [[2]].
After many failed tries, he finally found a clever way to hold the pieces together.
2.explanation_zh: 難處在於讓每層能轉動又不讓方塊「散開」，後文說找到把零件固定在一起的方法，故選 fall apart。

evidence: Soon the colors were all mixed up, and getting them back in order was far from easy.
It took Rubik more than a month to [[3]] his own puzzle!
3.explanation_zh: 顏色打亂後很難復原，花了一個多月才「解開」自己的謎題，故選 solve。

evidence: In 1977, it went on [[4]] in toy shops in Hungary.
A few years later, it was sold all over the world.
4.explanation_zh: go on sale 為固定片語「開始販售」，且接玩具店與後文 was sold，故選 sale。

evidence: Today, the cube [[5]] as one of the best-selling toys in history.
5.explanation_zh: be known as「被認為是／以…著稱」，主詞是方塊須用被動，故選 is known。

evidence: In 1974, Erno Rubik was a young design teacher in Budapest, Hungary.
His students found it hard to imagine how solid shapes move and turn, so he wanted to give them a model they could hold in their hands.
1.explanation_zh: 魯比克是設計老師，為了讓學生看懂立體形狀如何移動轉動才做出方塊，所以原本是用來 teaching 的工具；其餘三項與文中的老師與學生情境無關。

evidence: The hard part was letting each layer turn freely without making the whole cube [[2]].
After many failed tries, he finally found a clever way to hold the pieces together.
2.explanation_zh: 難處是讓每一層自由轉動又不讓整個方塊散開（fall apart），後句說找到把零件固定在一起的方法，與此呼應。

evidence: Soon the colors were all mixed up, and getting them back in order was far from easy.
It took Rubik more than a month to [[3]] his own puzzle!
3.explanation_zh: 顏色全混亂、要復原很不容易，所以他花了一個多月才解開（solve）自己做的謎題；sell、name、borrow 都不合 his own puzzle 的語意。

evidence: In 1977, it went on [[4]] in toy shops in Hungary.
4.explanation_zh: go on sale 是固定搭配，表示開始在玩具店販售，與後文 sold all over the world 呼應。

evidence: Today, the cube [[5]] as one of the best-selling toys in history.
5.explanation_zh: be known as 表示被認為是；方塊是被動地被稱為史上暢銷玩具之一，故用 is known，knows、is knowing 都不通。

A.evidence: In 1974, Erno Rubik was a young design teacher in Budapest, Hungary.
A.explanation_zh: cooking（烹飪）只看本句可填，但下一句說發明者是設計老師，接著說他想給學生一個能拿在手上的模型，方塊是為教學而做，和烹飪無關。

C.evidence: His students found it hard to imagine how solid shapes move and turn, so he wanted to give them a model they could hold in their hands.
C.explanation_zh: farming（農耕）：上下文談的是學生難以想像立體形狀，老師想給他們一個模型，和種田無關。

D.evidence: In 1974, Erno Rubik was a young design teacher in Budapest, Hungary.
D.explanation_zh: fishing（釣魚）：發明者是設計老師、做方塊是為了學生，和釣魚無關。

A.evidence: The hard part was letting each layer turn freely without making the whole cube [[2]].
A.explanation_zh: fall asleep（睡著）的主詞要是人或動物，木頭方塊不會睡著，說不通。

B.evidence: After many failed tries, he finally found a clever way to hold the pieces together.
B.explanation_zh: get lost（迷路、遺失）和轉動各層無關；下一句的 hold the pieces together 表示要避免的是方塊散開，不是遺失。

C.evidence: The hard part was letting each layer turn freely without making the whole cube [[2]].
C.explanation_zh: dry up（乾掉、枯竭）和「讓每一層自由轉動」無關，轉動不會讓方塊乾掉。

B.evidence: Soon the colors were all mixed up, and getting them back in order was far from easy.
B.explanation_zh: sell（賣）只看本句可填，但前一句說難的是把打亂的顏色排回原位，所以花一個多月做的是「解開」；而且下一段才說它 1977 年開始在店裡販售。

C.evidence: Soon the colors were all mixed up, and getting them back in order was far from easy.
C.explanation_zh: name（命名）只看本句可填，但前一句強調的是把顏色排回原位很不容易，花時間的是解謎，和取名字無關。

D.evidence: It took Rubik more than a month to [[3]] his own puzzle!
D.explanation_zh: borrow（借）：方塊是他自己做的（his own puzzle），不需要借，說不通。

A.evidence: In 1977, it went on [[4]] in toy shops in Hungary.
A.explanation_zh: go on a diet 是「節食」，要有冠詞 a，而且主詞是方塊、地點是玩具店，說不通。

B.evidence: In 1977, it went on [[4]] in toy shops in Hungary.
B.explanation_zh: go on vacation 是「去度假」，方塊不會在玩具店度假，說不通。

D.evidence: A few years later, it was sold all over the world.
D.explanation_zh: go on tour 用在樂團、表演者「巡迴演出」；下一句說它後來賣到全世界，空格要的是「開始販售」（go on sale）。

A.evidence: Today, the cube [[5]] as one of the best-selling toys in history.
A.explanation_zh: knows 是主動語態，「方塊知道……」說不通；the cube 和 know 是被動關係，後面又有 as，要用 is known as。

C.evidence: Today, the cube [[5]] as one of the best-selling toys in history.
C.explanation_zh: has known 仍是主動語態，主詞 the cube 和動作的關係不對。

D.evidence: Today, the cube [[5]] as one of the best-selling toys in history.
D.explanation_zh: know 是狀態動詞，通常不用進行式；is knowing 仍是主動，文法和意思都不對。
